8 Eyes.name: 8 Eyes
8 Eyes.summary:
8 Eyes is an action game set in a post-nuclear future where rebellious dukes have seized eight powerful jewels. Players control Orin the Falconer as he enters each duke’s castle, battles soldiers and mutants, defeats its guardian, and recovers the jewels for the Great King.

Orin fights with a sword and special weapons while directing his falcon, Cutrus. In the two-player mode, a second player controls Cutrus independently.

Battle Kid 2 - Mountain of Torment.name: Battle Kid 2: Mountain of Torment
Battle Kid 2 - Mountain of Torment.summary: The sequel to Battle Kid: Fortress of Peril by Sivak Games. Battle Kid 2 is a homebrew game, sold via Retrozone on unlicensed NES carts.

Burnin Rubber.name: Bump 'n' Jump
Burnin Rubber.summary: The NES port of Bump 'n' Jump, an overhead-view vehicular combat game developed by Data East and originally released in Japan as "Burnin' Rubber". The arcade version was available as both a dedicated board and as part of Data East's DECO Cassette System. It was distributed in North America by Bally Midway. The goal is to drive to the end of a level while bumping enemy vehicles into the sides of the track and jumping over large obstacles such as bodies of water.

F-15 City War.name: F-15 City War
F-15 City War.summary: Your city is under siege. Protect it or die. Jets. Tanks. Gun Boats. Giant Robots. Choppers. They're all out to destroy you. But you've got the power and speed of an F-15 behind you and all the ammo you need to decimate the enemy.

Raid on Bungeling Bay.name: Raid on Bungeling Bay
Raid on Bungeling Bay.summary: Raid on Bungeling Bay has the player controlling a helicopter which is on a mission to destroy everything that moves. The only ally is the carrier, which is where the player begins at each level and may return to for repair and pick up bombs, as long as the player manages to protect it from being destroyed. The main goal in each level is to destroy a factory, which requires a steady increasing amount of bombs. Enemy forces include ships, planes, tanks, anti-air guns, and eventually, a large battleship.

Super Donkey Kong 2.name: Super Donkey Kong 2
Super Donkey Kong 2.summary: ‎Super Donkey Kong 2 is a pirated Famicom port of the SNES game Donkey Kong Country 2: Diddy's Kong Quest published by NT in 1997. It greatly resembles Super Donkey Kong.

Tasac.name: Tasac
Tasac.summary: In A.D. 20XX, humans are engaged in fierce warfare with TASAC - the alien bionic mutants. Landsy and Dagrel, commanders of Earth Defense Arms, are encountering the toughest enemies known to man. They must destroy TASAC to rescue the Earth, otherwise humans will be turned into slaves under the TASAC terrorism!
